subject: Post-call: EdgeHealth POC — KPI commitments & onboarding plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@edgehealth.ai>, Devon Park <devon.park@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap — POC KPI commitments & next steps

Thanks for the productive demo earlier today — quick recap and proposed plan so we’re all aligned.

Highlights we agreed on the call (please confirm if I missed anything):
- Success criteria (technical):
  • Latency: p99 <= 250ms for median 512-token requests (99th including network).
  • Throughput: steady-state 60 requests/sec for the main inference route (batching allowed).
  • Cost: target gross token cost <= $0.85 / 1k tokens for the evaluated configuration.
  • Quality: automated QA pass-rate >= 92% on the annotated validation set (entity extraction + clinical intent).
  • Safety: <0.5% false-positive rate on safety filter for protected PHI-sensitive prompts.

- Operational commitments:
  • Redwood will provision a dedicated sandbox fleet (single-region us-west-2) for EdgeHealth evaluation.
  • We’ll run a 2-week benchmark window with your sample traffic and our standard prompt set.
  • Ownership: Ben (me) – trial lead / infra orchestration; Monica – onboarding & success metrics; Neha – security/compliance liaison.

Immediate next steps (proposed dates):
1) Ben to share Mutual Action Plan + kickoff folder (today EOD) — attachment: EdgeHealth_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx.
2) EdgeHealth to provide representative sample set (anonymized) and expected traffic profile by 2026-11-03.
3) Redwood to provision sandbox and share access + baseline benchmark script by 2026-11-05.
4) Benchmark window: 2026-11-08 through 2026-11-21.
5) Readout meeting and decision gate: 2026-11-24 — review latency/throughput/cost/quality and decide next steps.

Notes on measurement: we’ll provide the benchmark harness (k6 + tokenized workload) and a small eval harness that runs your annotated test set to compute the quality pass rate. We’ll track cost both at the token-level and as an aggregated cost per 1k inference units.

Ask for you: please confirm the sample dataset timeline above and overlap with any maintenance windows. Also confirm whether your security team needs additional artifacts (SOC2, encryption details) ahead of the sandbox. I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary we can share with your security contact.

Ben
